modelOverview: The Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet is the maison's contemporary round-cased collection, launched at SIHH 2019 as a modern counterpoint to the Royal Oak. Its signature is an ultra-thin octagonal middle case sandwiched between a round bezel and caseback, joined by openworked lugs and a double-curved sapphire crystal. The Selfwinding time-and-date models house the in-house automatic Calibre 4302 with a roughly 70-hour power reserve.
